name: KY-053 analog-digital converter (ADS1115)
not_buildable: It is not a sensor and talks over a data bus (I2C). It needs an extra Arduino library, and LearnLens only compiles sketches with its two approved libraries.
identification: Narrow black PCB printed ADS1115 with a small chip and a single row of 10 pins (VDD, GND, SCL, SDA, ADDR, ALRT, A0 to A3).

facts.statement: A 16-bit analog-digital converter with 4 inputs on the I2C bus; operating voltage 2 V to 5.5 V. The vendor's example uses the Adafruit ADS1X15 library.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-053, technical data and code example
